result.brief: 提出免训练的自校正优化方法，通过新事件与状态保持约束提升交错图文生成的时间一致性与主体保持，并可扩展至视频生成。
result.reason: Training-free self-correction for interleaved image-text generation, extending to video generation and physically grounded long-horizon processes; contributes to unified understanding-generation and video generation.
